_comment: Bar-line edit of v3 take 2 (music_v1, seed 3313) onto the v5 body clock (129.5 s; the H0 cold open has its own bed). v5 re-edit of the v4 arrangement (backup tools/audio-v3/_v3/data/arrangement.v4.json): the groove now ends exactly on a source bar at the hard stop (56 = source 62), so v4's half-bar repeat before the stop is gone; the Night drone re-enters 1 s after the stop and repeats 2 bars to fill to the riser; the drop sits on T1's start (72.5); from the drop to the landing (46 s, as in v4) and through the outro every source/film relation is v4's, 3.5 s earlier. Raw take: sparse glockenspiel intro 0-8; bright groove 8-64; low drone 64-73.5 fading to silence by 76; 1-bar riser 76-78; DROP on 78; driving groove 78-126; held chord 126-129 and a clean ring-out to silence by 133.9.

segments.why: M1-M3: the groove kicks in on hookLand (source bar 8 + 1 beat) and runs to source bar 62, the hard stop on musicStop
M4: hard stop; Night falls (the muted pluck is an SFX)
M4: the take's dark drone enters (beatless)
drone again from source bar 66 (a 2-bar repeat, s70 -> s66), its fade to silence, the 1-bar riser, the DROP on 72.5, the tech groove
M8/M9: the landing repeats one groove bar (s124 -> s122, as v4), then the held chord on 122.5 and the ring-out

gain.why: the drone sits under the heartbeat
near silence after the sub hit (the take's own fade continues to 70.5)
gentle extra fade so the take's ring-out still sounds at endPress and ends by 129

sweeps.why: Night: the drone darkened to a low pad
M7: the band drops to bass and tick for 2 bars from blocked
M8: high-pass build from T7's start, snapping back full on the landing

synth.why: M4: dull thud when the slip is used

subHits.why: M4: the deep sub hit (subHit) before 'So how does a buyer know it's clean?'

cues.what: glockenspiel pickup; the groove kicks in on hookLand 2.5
the same groove (no separate chorus in the take)
hard stop on 56, silence to 57, dark drone + heartbeat + ticks, thud 63, sub hit 64.5, near silence
fade to silence, 1-bar riser 70.5-72.5, DROP on 72.5
bass + tick for 2 bars (107-111), band back to 112.5
high-pass build 112.5-118.5, LANDING on 118.5 (sub hit, full band)
held chord on 122.5, ring-out faded by 129, silent 129-129.5
